review_scope: representative individual-renderer preflight before visual review

Unity reported invalid MinMaxAABB conversion and the representative capture contained zero visible pixels, so no shape-quality verdict is possible.
No valid black/gray proof PNG was produced; this is a technical preflight failure rather than a visual rejection.
The scene and prefab remained clean and the approved body hash was unchanged.

r4_binding_requirements.fixture: Add deterministic endpoint-unit coverage for start, interior and PI/end samples and fail offline preparation on any NaN or Infinity.
r4_binding_requirements.proof_limit: Return only a minimal representative isolated black/gray proof after the corrected generator compiles. Do not run composite, timeline, prefab completion or 30-cycle validation before a new Root decision.
